name: Bill Tzar

events.place: Selkirk Mental Health Centre, Selkirk, Manitoba, Canada
Saint John the Baptist Ukrainian Catholic Cemetery, Silver, Armstrong, Manitoba, Canada

notes:
Bill Tzar was born with an intellectual disability and was unable to make many choices on his own. Larry Lacko (I0005) recalls Bill walking down the farm road from the corner house where he lived with his mother Katie (I2163) and her brother Harry (I2162) to help with farm chores on the Rychlicki farm.

According to Pearl Lacko (I0099), Bill Tzar and his mother Katie Tzar (Ksenia Powroznik, I2163) went to live with Katie's brother Harry (I2162) after Katie was abandoned by her husband (surname Tzar).

Katie died in 1968 and Harry died in 1982. According to Larry Lacko, at some point after that, Bill lived at the Selkirk Mental Health Centre until his death in 1996.

According to Pearl Lacko, her and her brothers Nick and John bought a new headstone for Bill, since the old one was deteriorating.
